facts.engagement_model: hybrid agile execution: fixed scope anchors for Chemical/Nylon/Compounding BU phases with sprint-based configuration delivery
facts.team_size: Ascend internal roles: 1–2 FTEs for Program Governance, 6–8 FTEs for Business Process Ownership, 3–5 FTEs for Technical & Data Ownership; 6–8 BPOs active presence across all 3 BU waves is required; ~2,100 employees in deployment scope; 1,181 users referenced for role-based training
facts.scope_summary: SAP S/4HANA 2025 implementation for 25 active company codes across Chemical, Nylon, and Compounding business units, with phased rollout by BU and a global template. Scope includes core ERP modules, SAP BTP-based extensibility, integrations, data migration of open transactions/balances/active master data, program/project management, OCM, testing, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer.

assumptions: Public Cloud is Bristlecone's recommended path
Overall public-cloud timeline is ~11 months end-to-end
Overall private-cloud timeline is ~18 months end-to-end
Open transactions, balances and active master data will be migrated; no historical data load
Historical data will remain in ECC read-only for compliance, audit and reference
CVI remediation is a mandatory parallel pre-project workstream and starts before Prepare kick-off
CVI cannot run during implementation
3 mock data loads are planned before each BU go-live / production cutover
~10 external systems and ~15 interfaces per system are assumed
API-first, event-driven integration architecture via SAP BTP / CPI; OData / Events / IDoc mandatory for Public Cloud
Compounding goes first in Public Cloud at M8; Chemical and Nylon follow at M10
Private Cloud sequencing is Global Template → Chemical → Nylon → Compounding
Global Build completion at M8 is the single gate for Chemical and Nylon in Public Cloud
Chemical BU go-live at M14 is the single gate for Nylon and Compounding in Private Cloud
Dedicated Ascend internal ownership is required; under-staffing creates program risk
Infrastructure Lead is required for Private Cloud only; not needed for Public Cloud
Upgrade cadence for Private Cloud to be agreed at program start, with minimum annual upgrade cycle
RICEFW baseline is fixed at Explore Q-Gate in Private Cloud; additions require Change Board approval and formal change request
ECC read-only access target retirement is within 18 months of final BU go-live once Microsoft Fabric OneLake ingestion covers compliance periods
Bristlecone will provide full SI delivery capability, but Ascend must staff key internal roles
